title: Selling vs Marketing Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 1
description:
Zoya and her Nani made fifty delicious millet laddoos, and Zoya sold only eight. Why? She never asked what people wanted. In this animated lesson we meet Laddoo Lab, a tiny snack brand from a home kitchen in Bengaluru, and use it to understand what marketing really is.

You will see Philip Kotler and Gary Armstrong's textbook definition of marketing, what value means, and a live side-by-side run of the selling way (make first, then push) against the marketing way (ask first, then make). We hear Peter Drucker on the aim of marketing, watch the exchange between Laddoo Lab and its first regular customer Mrs. Rao turn into a relationship, and walk through the marketing process in five steps. Then we see needs, value, exchange and relationships at work today, in a phone maker, a bank, a bakery and a food delivery app. We also look at the human side honestly: marketing helps people find what they need, but false claims hurt, and in India the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 allows fines of up to Rs 10 lakh for misleading ads.

This is Episode 1 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
